A letter to you

My dearest Shivani,

I know I hurt you with the things I said. I got angry, and I wasn't there for you when you needed me. I am truly sorry. You deserved patience, care and understanding from me — not words that made you feel small or alone.

I also realise that some of my actions may have made you misunderstand what I feel for you. I never wanted you to think that I am here just for physical closeness or lust. That is not what your place in my life means to me.

From today, I want to be more careful with your feelings and your boundaries. I will never assume that I have a right to touch or kiss you. I will always ask and respect your answer. I don't want affection that makes you uncomfortable. I want to be close to you in the ways that matter most — mentally, emotionally, and with genuine love.

I know an apology cannot undo what happened, and I don't expect you to forget it just because I wrote this. I want to show you through my actions that I can listen better, control my anger, and be present when you need me.

Your birthday is coming on 26 November, and more than anything, I wish for you to feel loved, peaceful and happy. I don't want this apology to put pressure on you or take away from your special day. I just hope, when you're ready, you'll find a little space in your heart to forgive me.

I'm sorry for hurting someone who means so much to me. I love you, and I want to love you with more patience, respect and care.

With all my heart,
Yours ❤️
What I want you to know

I don't just want to be beside you in the happy moments. I want to learn how to be there for you in the difficult ones, too.

26 · 11 · A day for you

Happy Birthday,
Shivani.

May this year be gentle with you, bring you closer to every dream you carry, and give you a thousand reasons to smile. You deserve all the beautiful things life has to offer.

Made with love, honesty, and the hope of doing better.
One heart. One honest apology.
